title: Export decision data without leaking future outcomes
narrative: Offline study needs decision-time features without future outcome leakage. Missing labels stay missing.
implementation:
`DecisionRecord` / `DecisionLog` / `export_offline_dataset` persist append-only learning records and versioned exports without default future leakage.

Covers: OBS-02.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/export_train.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
